high_level_description: This image is an aerial photograph of the India Gate monument in New Delhi, India. The photo appears to be historical, as it shows the area around the monument in its early stages of development. The India Gate is prominently featured in the center of the image, with its iconic arch structure clearly visible. Surrounding the monument, there are wide open spaces that have been landscaped with trees and pathways. The trees are relatively small, indicating that they were in their initial stages of growth when the photo was taken.
